rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone who behaves as if superior to others.

example.english: They are always so haughty that nobody wants to work with them.
example.traditional: 佢成日擺出一副高傲嘅樣，搞到冇人想同佢合作。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baai2 ceot1 jat1 fu3 gou1 ngou6 ge3 joeng6 gaau2 dou3 mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 hap6 zok3

rows.note: Use this when the person's haughtiness specifically shows disregard or contempt for other people.

example.english: They are so haughty that they even ignore the manager when he speaks to them.
example.traditional: 佢目中無人，連經理同佢講嘢都當聽唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 muk6 zung1 mou4 jan4 lin4 ging1 lei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5 dou1 dong3 teng1 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the haughty attitude comes across as cocky, rude, or insolent.

example.english: Don't be so haughty; you only won one match.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁串，贏咗一場波啫。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cyun3 jeng4 zo2 jat1 coeng4 bo1 ze1
